[Intro]
[A]

[Verse 1]
[A]I pulled into [C#m]Nazareth, was
[D]feeling 'bout half past [A]dead
[A]I just need some place [C#m]where
[D]I can lay my head [A]
[A]Hey, mister, can you [C#m]tell me, where a
[D]man might find a bed? [A]
[A]He just grinned and [C#m]shook my hand,
[D]"No" was all he said. [A]

[Chorus]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
[A]take a [A/G#]load for free [D]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
and you
put the load right on me

[Break]
[A]  [E/G#]  [F#m]  [E]
[D]

[Verse 2]
[A]I picked up my bags, [C#m]I went
[D]looking for a place to hide [A]
[A]When I saw old [C#m]Carmen and the Devil, walk-
[D]ing side by side [A]
[A]I said, "Hey, [C#m]Carmen, c'mon,
[D]let's go [A]downtown"
[A]She said, [C#m]"I gotta go, but my
[D]friend can stick around" [A]

[Chorus]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
[A]take a [A/G#]load for free [D]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
and you
put the load right on me

[Break]
[A]  [E/G#]  [F#m]  [E]
[D]

[Verse 3]
[A]Go down, Miss [C#m]Moses, ain't
[D]nothin' you can say [A]
[A]It's just old [C#m]Luke, and Luke's
[D]waiting on the judgment day [A]
[A]Well, Luke, my friend, [C#m]what a-
[D]bout young Annalee [A]
[A]He said, "Do me a [C#m]favor, son, won't you
[D]stay and keep Annalee [A]company"

[Chorus]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
[A]take a [A/G#]load for free [D]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
and you
put the load right on me

[Break]
[A]  [E/G#]  [F#m]  [E]
[D]

[Verse 4]
[A]Crazy Chester [C#m]followed me, and he
[D]caught me in the fog [A]
[A]Said, "I will fix [C#m]your rag, if
[D]you'll take Jack, my dog" [A]
[A]I said, "Wait a minute [C#m]Chester, you know,
[D]I'm a peaceful man" [A]
[A]He said, "That's okay, [C#m]boy, won't you
[D]feed him when you can" [A]

[Chorus]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
[A]take a [A/G#]load for free [D]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
and you

[D]

[D]

[Verse 5]
[A]Catch the [C#m]cannonball, now to
[D]take me down the line [A]
[A]My bag is [C#m]sinking low, and I
[D]do believe it's time [A]
[A]To get back to Miss [C#m]Fanny, you know
[D]she's the only one [A]
[A]Who sent me here, [C#m]with her re-
[D]gards for everyone [A]

[Chorus]
[A]Take a [A/G#]load off [D]Fanny,
